description:
A destiny where I'm only popular with girls?" Hangyeol, who has a boyish appearance, has always been uniquely popular among girls. Believing she had always accommodated others because she hated conflict, Hangyeol realizes through her best friend's backstabbing that her 'easygoing nature' was actually 'frustrating.' After failing miserably in her attempt to become an 'ordinary girl' upon entering college, she accidentally joins a film club where she starts getting tangled up with 'strange' women who each harbor their own flaws. Caught somewhere between an emotional dumping ground and a pillar of support for them, this is Hangyeol's coming-of-age story as she gets tossed around and finds her true self.

**Original Webtoon:**
